cohort: 292,253 women having singleton delivery in Finland in 2007-2011
finding: An attempt at vaginal delivery is the safest way to deliver even for high-risk women, with the exception of women with pre-eclampsia, who had a similar risk in an attempt at vaginal delivery and elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: The total complication rate was lowest in vaginal deliveries (VD) in all risk groups.
